detail.longDescription: You know, I'm a little bit too young to have experienced programs distributed via computing magazines in their prime, but I always thought it was crazy that people would sit down and type in pages and pages of PEEKs, POKEs, and all the rest "just" to end up with a word processor or simple game or something. ...now that I'm dealing with so much AI slop and "human in the loop" review bullshit I'm thinking about what a great deal that was. # computing # retrocomputing # programming # ai
